questions: "Have you noticed a tremor in your hands that happens when they are resting on your lap?"
"Do you feel stiffness or slowness in your movements compared to before?"

"Do you act out your dreams or talk in your sleep?"

"Do the movements get worse when you are stressed or anxious?"
"Did you ever have tics when you were younger, such as blinking, throat clearing, or other repetitive movements?"

"How old are you?"
"Is there any family history of movement disorders or neurological conditions?"
"Do you have any family members with similar symptoms?"
"Do you have any anxiety or depression?"
"Did the symptoms begin after a stressful life event?"
"Do you notice the movements disappear completely when you are asleep?"
"Can you count backward from 100 by 7s?" (while observing if movements change with distraction)
"Do the movements affect both sides equally or is one side worse?"
"Do you have any difficulty with balance or walking?"
"Have you noticed any changes in your handwriting?"
"Have you noticed any involuntary movements of your limbs that you cannot control?"
"Have you experienced any seizures or episodes of unresponsiveness?"
"Do you have any difficulty swallowing or biting your tongue?"
"Have you noticed any muscle cramps or rippling movements in your muscles?"
"Are you an adult over the age of 40?"
"Did these movements start before the age of 20?"
"Are the movements continuous or do they come and go in episodes?"
